name: Aksharantar (AI4Bharat), Punjabi
licence_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar/raw/main/README.md (Licensing Information, read 2026-11-12): "Manually collected data: Released under CC-BY license. Mined dataset (from Samanantar and IndicCorp): Released under CC0 license. Existing sources: Released under CC0 license." Same terms as the Malayalam file (aksharantar.json); the same source filter is applied.
attribution: Aksharantar by AI4Bharat (Madhani et al., 2022), CC BY and CC0. Includes names from Wikidata (CC0).
verdict_reason: The Punjabi files have 'Dakshina Dataset' and 'Existing sources' rows, which the filter in training/mlkb/data/human.py drops (the project's licence audit keeps them out of a pack): 62,392 Dakshina and 4,276 Existing rows are dropped by the filter. What is used is mined (IndicCorp, Samanantar: CC0), Wikidata (CC0) or AI4Bharat's manual collection (AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF: CC BY).
used_for: pan_train.json rows (IndicCorp with mining score >= -0.2, Samanantar, Wikidata) as transliterator training pairs for packs/pa.neopack. Punjabi has manual rows only in pan_test.json, so the romanised Punjabi tables (data/langs/pa/romanisation.json) are fitted to the mined IndicCorp rows of pan_valid.json, which also validate training. pan_test.json's manual rows (AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF, CC BY) are the held-out eval set: its words are left out of every training pair.
notes: Fetched 2026-11-12. Extract with: unzip pan.zip -d data/raw/aksharantar-pan/extracted (data/build-pa-text.sh does). pan_train.json has 514,724 rows: IndicCorp 398,968, Samanantar 55,290, Dakshina 50,468, Wikidata 5,722, Existing 4,276 (no manual rows). pan_valid.json 8,880: Dakshina 4,974, IndicCorp 2,680, Samanantar 968, Wikidata 258 (no manual rows). pan_test.json 11,237: Dakshina 6,950, AK-Freq 2,194, AK-NEI 1,234, AK-NEF 859. The CC0 statement says 'We do not own any of the text from which this data has been extracted': mined pairs are single words, which we treat as unprotectable on their own.
status: in packs/pa.neopack, a file handed out for a trial, not offered for download, not in the app
